Label: war of choice
Note: Moralised label; attributes the decision to start the war to Putin.

Label: war of aggression
Note: Legal term (UN Charter/ICC); becomes the dominant US label from March 2022.

Label: full-scale invasion
Note: Scalar variant marking the 24 Feb escalation.

Label: war machine
Note: Metonymic label for Russia's defence-industrial base.

Label: war of Russia on Ukraine
Note: Blinken phrasing at the UNSC (via interpreter).

Label: special military operation
Note: US cites the Kremlin term only in scare quotes, as a euphemism to be rejected.
